semiconductor_relevance: High — AHIKO FINETEC provides critical materials and processing services for semiconductor manufacturing, including optical glass, quartz, and crystalline materials.
summary: AHIKO FINETEC specializes in the integrated processing of materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing. The company offers cutting, polishing, and film deposition services, utilizing advanced techniques such as Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) and Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD). Their expertise supports the production of mask plate blanks and other components for electronic and optical devices.
capabilities: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) including sputtering and evaporation
